unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Categorical group labels (NC, HFD) for the first plot, and ratio names (LW/BW, FW/BW) for the second plot; no unit needed for categorical axes.

First sub-plot y-axis is explicitly labeled 'Body weight (g)', giving units in grams. Second sub-plot y-axis shows LW/BW and FW/BW, which per the caption are 'liver weight over body weight' and 'visceral fat weight over BW', i.e., dimensionless mass ratios that do not require a unit.
Categorical group labels (NC, HFD); no unit needed.
Y-axis is explicitly labeled '5mC/Methyl Blue (ratio)', identifying it as a dimensionless ratio of two signal intensities, which does not require a physical unit.
Categorical group labels (TET1, TET2, TET3, each split by NC/HFD); no unit needed.
Y-axis is explicitly labeled 'Ratio (TETs/GAPDH)', identifying it as a dimensionless band-intensity ratio, which does not require a physical unit.
